entries.22bdebf98242f35e: Its mission is 'Digital for not making people unhappy.' Through the sale of its digital marketing support business and some media businesses, it completed a restructuring into a 'Fintech Focus' structure aimed at expanding the total transaction value of the fintech business, and it plans to make the fintech business its core business, with three focus areas (marketing (advertising), human resources, and DX (finance) in payments), aiming to expand its share in the field of payments to individuals of ¥30,000 or less. It is also advancing the rollout of a digital wallet that supports the Funds Transfer Business.
